desc: Ideation: reduce to "g feasible iff g | A_i and cnt[g] >= K"; sieve over values 1..M in O(M log M + N)
Implement full solution: fast parse into `array('i')`; in-place ascending sieve `cnt[d] = sum(cnt[d::d])`; build `best` by ascending slice assignment for feasible d; buffered output

Verify edge cases: K=1 (answer A_i), K=N (only d=1 feasible), duplicates, all-coprime arrays, GCD candidates not present in A; in-place sieve correctness confirmed (multiples of d are >= d, only indices < d overwritten); memory ~50MB and runtime ~1.4e7 C-level operations, both within limits
